meta.name: pivot-on-ioc
meta.description: Explore GTI relationships for an IOC to discover related entities. Use to expand investigation by finding connected domains, IPs, files, or threat actors. Takes an IOC and relationship types to query.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据威胁情报线索发现关联实体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析IOC并需要扩展关联信息
copy.tagline_en: Discover related entities from threat intelligence indicators
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing IOCs and need to expand related entities

howto.what: Claude会利用Google Threat Intelligence，根据你提供的IOC（如IP、域名、文件哈希）查询与之相关的实体（如关联的域名、IP、文件、威胁行为者），并将发现的新IOC和威胁上下文汇总输出。
howto.when: 当你提供一个IOC（IP、域名、文件哈希、URL或Collection）并指定要查询的关系类型时触发。例如，在调查恶意文件时，想找它连接的域名。

say.text: 查一下这个IP关联的通信文件
say.note: 会返回与该IP通信的文件列表

say.text: 找出这个域名的子域名和解析记录
say.note: 会返回子域名和IP解析历史

say.text: 分析这个文件哈希联系的域名
say.note: 会返回文件通信的域名列表

howto.what_en: Claude uses Google Threat Intelligence to query relationships for an IOC (IP, domain, file hash, URL, or collection) and returns related entities such as domains, IPs, files, threat actors, along with expanded IOCs and threat context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an IOC and specify relationship types to explore. Typically during threat investigation or hunting to expand leads.

say_en.text: Check communicating files for this IP
say_en.note: Returns list of files that communicated with the IP

say_en.text: Find subdomains and resolutions for this domain
say_en.note: Returns subdomains and IP resolution history

say_en.text: Analyze domains contacted by this file hash
say_en.note: Returns domains that the file communicated with
